title: Eraneos is an international strategy and transformation group at enterprise scale
content:
The record for Eraneos holds two things: it is an international strategy and transformation group based in Zurich, and it is enterprise scale. That is the whole basis of its priority 3 deferral — positioning plus a size bracket, with no headcount, no delivery evidence and no open-source posture assessed.

The positioning alone is worth noting, because a strategy and transformation consultancy is a different animal from a systems integrator. Its deliverable is advice and programme design rather than running software, so even a willing partner may not be the party that builds and operates the record layer. That is a question the row does not answer.

This entry is therefore best treated as a directory sighting rather than a lead assessment: confirmation that Eraneos appears as a Flowable partner in Zurich, with everything that would decide the case still to be gathered. Provenance is the Flowable Partner Finder (flowable.com/company/partners), mined 2026-08-18, and the row has not been imprint-swept.
